name: Tainted Scar
summary: In the southwestern Blasted Lands, demons gather beneath Lord Kazzak’s command. Fel magic has made the Tainted Scar their stronghold.

sections.title: A Bastion of the Legion
sections.body:
Where the Black Morass once spread, the Tainted Scar now cuts through the land as a lifeless trench stained like dried blood. Fel energies from the Dark Portal drained the wetlands and twisted the ground. After Archimonde fell at Mount Hyjal during the Third War, the surviving Burning Legion forces rallied in the south.

The colossal ered'ruin Lord Kazzak claimed the Scar for his stronghold. Elite demons hold its blackened rises, while lieutenants such as Razelikh the Defiler command the wasted red soil.

sections.title: Unholy Inhabitants
sections.body:
Most mortals avoid the Tainted Scar, where death comes in agony. Yet fel energies draw those who practice the dark arts. Daio the Decrepit, an eccentric human warlock, lives beside a ruined demonic altar that overlooks the horrors.

He uses the fiends around him in dark rituals. There, he teaches aspiring warlocks to summon and bind dread infernals.

aliases: why is the ground red here
faq.answer: The Tainted Scar cuts through the southwestern Blasted Lands, corrupted by demonic magic from the Dark Portal. Once part of the Black Morass, it withered into a barren, blood-red wasteland where high-ranking Burning Legion demons now dwell.

Lord Kazzak rules the Tainted Scar. After the Burning Legion's defeat in the Third War, the towering doomguard commander rallied the surviving demons in the south and keeps a deadly foothold on Azeroth.

faq.q: Why is an old human living among the demons here?
faq.answer: Daio the Decrepit is an aged human warlock who lives among the demons to harness the Scar's potent fel energies. At a ruined demonic altar, he performs dark rituals and mentors seasoned warlocks in summoning infernals.

faq.q: Is the Tainted Scar connected to the Dark Portal?
faq.answer: Yes. When the Dark Portal first breached the boundary between worlds, chaotic Nether energies spilled into the surrounding swamps. The Tainted Scar absorbed much of this magic, twisting the land into an inhospitable demonic stronghold.

angles.text: Veteran warlocks seek Daio the Decrepit at his demonic altar. There, they learn to enslave and command fiery infernals.
Alliance commanders watch the canyon closely. They fear Lord Kazzak's entrenched demon army could surge north into the Swamp of Sorrows or Stormwind territory.
